verdict.rationale: Yapily's docs claim a platform capability to categorise transaction data with merchant detection, which covers categories and some form of merchant identification. The evidence is a single short overview line, with no API reference detail on the enriched fields. The logo evidence (docs-11) is about UI branding, not merchant logos, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: merchant logos, explicit cleaned merchant-name output, API reference documentation of enrichment fields, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, raw bank transactions come back enriched — cleaned merchant names, categories, and logos — documented as a capability of the platform, not left as an exercise for me

citations.quote: Categorise and analyse transaction data with merchant detection and spending insights.
